name: BlueMeme Inc.
summary: BlueMeme Inc., headquartered in Tokyo, Japan since its start in 2006, works in digital transformation and low-code technology with an emphasis on agile methods. Its products include Outsystems, Marklogic, a multi-model database, and Workato, an integration automation platform. Services include consulting on architecture, leading agile projects, building custom low-code systems, training low-code engineers, and software sales and support.
